privacy.metaDescription: Understand how Mangora collects, uses and protects your company data.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: Learn which data we use, why it is needed and which controls are available for your company.

sections.collectedBody: We collect the data provided at sign up and the records needed to deliver the subscribed features.
sections.usageBody: The data is used to authenticate users, deliver features, provide support, improve the experience and protect the platform.
sections.rightsBody: You may request information, correction, portability or deletion of data, subject to applicable legal deadlines and retention duties.

terms.metaDescription: Read the terms and conditions for using the Mangora platform.
terms.title: Terms of use
terms.description: These conditions explain the basic rules for using the Mangora platform safely and responsibly.

sections.useBody: By creating an account you state that the information provided is true and that you are authorised to manage the data of the registered company.
sections.availabilityBody: We aim to keep the service available and reliable. Demo features may not persist information while the API integration is not active.
sections.responsibilitiesBody: Mangora assists the business operation but does not replace specialised accounting, tax, legal or financial advice.
